established: Apple documents paired source sync identifier/string and sync version/number, available from iOS11. Greater versions replace prior matching identifiers; the installed SDK agrees.
Current meal/water metadata is a custom local ID, without HealthKit sync identity/version. Weight has neither stable event identity nor durable external intent.
Existing linked-file staging can place several changed files into one recoverable local directory swap; preserving exact unrelated files and revision/live-state guards remains necessary.
notEstablished: The retrieved symbol pages do not explicitly establish callback outcome and replay behavior for equal versions, source collisions, deleted identifiers or multi-component arrays. Do not infer exactly-once delivery from greater-version replacement.
No actual same-version Health replay, source isolation, permission denial, partial meal outcome or signed-device result has been tested.
No queue schema, idempotency API or migration policy has been accepted or implemented.
designQuestionsToResolve: Stable payload identity must distinguish water, meal nutrient component and each weight event; do not reuse one meal identifier for all sample types without proving HealthKit matching scope.
Acknowledgement failure and success-before-ack replay need adapter and separately real Health evidence, including same-version semantics.

A journal inside the replaced data directory risks losing pending deletes during restore; a separate file risks a non-atomic local/intent commit. Resolve that transaction and lifecycle boundary explicitly.
Archive import must not replay another device’s external intent. Reset currently leaves Health data untouched; do not silently change that contract.
Per-type write permission and unavailable Health must remain pending/failed states, not fabricated success. Scope deletions to this source and stable record identity.
